verified for 2025 and 2026 weeks 1-3 caches only

withdrawn: The earlier conditional spans (OL 2000+, QB 2007+, receivers/RB 2000+, defense 2019+/2023+, common 2019+/2023+) are WITHDRAWN: they were inferred from release dates and missed the 17-game reference requirement, the FTN pressure-field contract and unverified component coverage.

qbIndex.why: season Y-1 must be a 17-game season (2021+) for a valid reference (B6)
qbIndex.status: NOT ASSERTABLE (B1); 2022 is a necessary lower bound only

olIndex.why: valid reference needs a 17-game season Y-1 (B6); otherwise OL falls back to the bundle
olIndex.status: NOT ASSERTABLE (B1); 2022 is a necessary lower bound only

receiverIndex.why: season Y-1 reference population needs B1 fields

defenseIndex.why: coverage and run-defense priors need B1; pass rush depends on the B4 replay policy; the PFR prior branch would need Y-1 >= 2018 and component coverage that is not verified

common.why: QB and OL cannot start before 2022 under current semantics; all units remain blocked by B1

burnIn: Every unit needs season Y-1 inputs (prior and/or reference) and Y-1 must be a 17-game season for QB/OL; burn-in seasons are not display-eligible. Weeks 2-11 also need a verified Elo chain ending at Y-1.
